fields.Name: T195 - Communication Providers Detail
fields.Description: Opens the Communication app's Providers section and opens a single provider's detail/configuration. Verifies the provider detail view renders.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Communication application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) - the pinned app list is short and Communication is visible without scrolling. Open the Providers section, then click a provider entry to open its detail or configuration view. If a preview panel appears, click 'Open Full Record' to load the full detail form. The success state is a single provider's detail/configuration view rendered, showing the provider's fields/settings OR its full record form. If the Providers list is empty in this fresh regression DB, it is acceptable for the success state to be the Providers list/configuration view rendering with a valid empty-state. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for content rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Communication application is active and the Providers section was opened
A single provider's detail/configuration view renders (its fields/settings or full record form), or the Providers view renders with a valid empty-state when no providers exist
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
